info.title: Tuition Media API
info.description:
Backend for Tuition Media. Every path is under `/api/v1`. Send the access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/google` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Errors share one body (`ErrorResponse`); match on `code`.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Match on this.

details.description: Ids related to the error. Omitted on masked 5xx responses.

issues.description: One entry per zod issue. Sent only with VALIDATION_ERROR.

get.description:
Returns 503 with status degraded when the database does not answer.

**Who:** Public.

**Rate limit:** global 100/min.

500.description: Unexpected error. In production the message is masked

post.summary: Sign in or sign up with Google
post.description:
Verifies the Google ID token. Sign-up sends role (and optionally consentVersion); sign-in omits role. An unknown Google account with no role gets 404. A blocked account, or a deleted account signing in without a role, gets 403. Returns an access token and a refresh token.

**Who:** Public.

**Rate limit:** global 100/min.

500.description: Unexpected error. In production the message is masked

post.description:
Revokes the old refresh token and returns a new access token and refresh token. Returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED when the token is unknown, revoked or expired, or the account is not ACTIVE.

**Who:** Public.

get.description:
Tutor browse (#46). OPEN requirements from ACTIVE students. scope=nearby matches requirements whose student pin is inside one of the tutor's zones, or whose area is in the tutor's service areas; scope=all skips the location match. scope=set lists requirements that match one of the tutor's own active sets (setId, required) by curriculum, level, subject and area; the manual filters are ignored in that mode. Filters: curriculum, levelCode, subjectId, areaId. Newest first, keyset cursor. No matching score is applied yet. noServiceArea is true when the tutor has no zones and no areas.

**Who:** TUTOR.

**Rate limit:** 300/min per account.

post.description:
#51. A tutor publishes a package offer: title, what it covers, duration in weeks and the total price in BDT. The placement fee is a percentage of that price. It goes live right away (admin moderation is not built yet). Fails with 403 PROFILE_INCOMPLETE until the profile passes the apply gate; the default requirement set is not needed. Fails with 400 INVALID_REQUIREMENT (fields subjectIds or zoneIds) when a subject is not on the profile or a zone is not one of the tutor's zones. The package needs a zone or teachesOnline (400 VALIDATION_ERROR on zoneIds). syncProfileSubjects adds missing subjects to the profile in the same transaction.

**Who:** TUTOR.

**Rate limit:** 60/min per account.

The merged values are checked with the same rules as create (400 VALIDATION_ERROR with issues, one per field). subjectIds and zoneIds replace the lists when sent, and subjects must be on the profile and zones must be the tutor's own.
